events.text: The Red Stars joined the WPSL Elite League.

events.quote: In 2012 , the Red Stars joined the former WPS Boston Breakers and Western New York Flash to found the WPSL Elite League .

events.text: The Red Stars won the 2012 National Womens Cup.
